name: Tracking event plan
summary: Before analytics goes onto a website or app, the founder or product owner gets one plan: the events and properties worth collecting, when each fires, where it goes, what it is called and who owns it, each tied to a question the business needs answered. The owner approves what is collected.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of analytics and reporting work, and its own method for planning what a website or app should record.
